primitives.name: Defensive Alignment Signature
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Alignment features add ~0.01 AUC (ablation) Follow-up to the pre-snap baseline, but at **play level** (98,579 plays) with defensive alignment as a signature: counts of every `lined_up_position` value per play, plus formation, alignment, down, distance, motion, quarter and scores.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'AUC': 'Area Under Curve, dimensionless', 'play': 'discrete event, countable', 'lined_up_position': 'categorical label, discrete'}
primitives.assumptions: Alignment features are independent of down/distance/score state; predictive performance measured via binary classification AUC.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When down/distance/score fully specify play outcome, alignment becomes redundant.

layer2.mapping: Encodes positional distribution as kernel function over play state space; used in GSE transition dynamics.
layer2.telemetry: Change in AUC upon ablation of lu_* columns.

primitives.name: AUC Improvement from Alignment Ablation
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Full model: **AUC 0.7045**, Brier 0.1779 (base 0.2036) - Same model with **every** `lu_*` alignment column dropped: **AUC 0.6939**, Brier 0.1798 So the entire defensive alignment signature is worth **+0.0106 AUC**.
primitives.assumptions: Model performance measured via held-out test set; ablation removes all alignment-related features.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Performance degradation when alignment features removed entirely.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to information-theoretic mutual information I(\text{alignment}; \text{outcome}) under conditional independence assumption.
layer2.telemetry: Quantified marginal gain in discriminative power.

primitives.name: Pre-Snap Shape Redundancy
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Interpretation Pre-snap shape (who stands where, in categorical buckets) is nearly redundant once down, distance and score state are present.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'shape': 'categorical configuration, discrete', 'state': 'tuple of (down, distance, score), continuous'}
primitives.assumptions: Conditional entropy H(shape | state) approaches zero; pre-snap shape does not add new information beyond state variables.
primitives.breakdown_regime: High correlation between pre-snap shape and post-state variables.

layer2.mapping: Kernel derived from conditional entropy; used in GSI feature selection via mutual information maximization.
layer2.telemetry: Mutual information I(shape; outcome) under fixed state.
